### Wisdom from the Psalms 7/4
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-7-or-4-552426.html
Passage: Psalms 83:14-15
Points:
- Independence Day fireworks serve as a reminder of the destructive nature of war and the longing for peace.
- The devastation caused by armed conflict should prompt reflection on the severe consequences of human hostility.
- Experiencing a healthy sense of fear can clear the mind and bring people back to their senses.
- Revering the Lord encourages people to evaluate their lives and draw closer to God.
- Believers are called to pray for freedom, peace, and those living in terror amidst ongoing conflict.
